newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Manitoba posts Q1 C$183 mln deficit.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Manitoba posts Q1 C$183 mln deficit.

text.p: The western Canadian province of Manitoba posted a deficit of C$183 million in the first quarter of fiscal 1997 (April/March), Manitoba's finance minister said.
The first-quarter deficit compared to a deficit of C$252 million in the first quarter of fiscal 1996.

The budgeted year end surplus of C$22 million was not revised despite additional spending due to spring flooding, forest fires and reduced lottery revenues from a casino strike, Finance Minster Eric Stefanson said in a statement.
Federal funding for emergency expenses and the "strong performance" of revenues from retail sales taxes should offset the additional first-quarter spending, he said.
